info.title: Shipstar API
info.description: Public Shipstar REST API (v1). Authenticate with an API token from the dashboard: Authorization: Bearer <token>. For agent access prefer the MCP server at https://mcp.shipstar.ai/mcp (OAuth 2.1, streamable HTTP). Responses carry standard RateLimit-* headers (and Retry-After on 429) so clients can self-throttle. Versioning & deprecation policy: https://docs.shipstar.ai/api-reference/versioning

get.description:
Get the announcement banner currently live for a project.
With an API token, the token's project; without one, the Shipstar
house project (what shipstar.ai renders). Exactly one banner is live
per project — publishing a new one replaces it. 404 when none is
live (never published, replaced, or past its take-down time).

link_url.description: Where the call-to-action points; null when the banner has no link

expires_at.description: When the banner stops being served, if a take-down was set

get.description:
Pages through a mailing list's recipients, oldest first. Each item carries
    `email`, `name`, `external_id`, `attributes`, `status`
    (`active` | `removed` | `unsubscribed`) and `status_changed_at`.

    Filter with `status`, search email / name / external_id with `q`, and
    follow `next_cursor` (pass it back as `cursor`) until it is null. `limit`
    is 100 by default and at most 500.

    ## Authentication
    Requires an API token (created in the dashboard). Pass it as a Bearer
    token in the Authorization header:
    ```
    Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN
    ```

post.summary: Add recipients to a mailing list
post.description:
Append-only bulk add. Send up to 1000 entries per request, either plain
    addresses or objects with `email` plus optional `name`, `external_id` and
    `attributes`:
    ```
    {"emails": ["one@example.com",
                {"email": "two@example.com", "name": "Sam", "external_id": "usr_42"}]}
    ```

    Each address is validated individually; invalid entries are returned in
    `invalid` rather than failing the batch. Addresses already on the list —
    active, removed or unsubscribed — are counted in `skipped_existing` and
    left untouched, so re-syncing never resurrects an opt-out. To update or
    reactivate existing contacts use `PUT` (upsert) instead. A list holds at
    most 500 active recipients.

    ## Authentication
    Requires an API token (created in the dashboard). Pass it as a Bearer
    token in the Authorization header:
    ```
    Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN
    ```
    The list must belong to the token's project. List ids come from
    `GET /email/lists`.

put.description:
Idempotent add-or-update — the call to sync your own user base against.
    Send up to 1000 entries, plain addresses or objects:
    ```
    {"recipients": [{"email": "sam@example.com", "name": "Sam Lee", "external_id": "usr_42",
                     "attributes": {"plan": "pro"}}]}
    ```

    Matching is by `external_id` first (your own user id), else by email, so a
    contact whose address changes is updated in place when you key by
    `external_id`. Contacts you previously removed are reactivated; active ones
    are updated (`attributes` replaces the stored map when provided); contacts
    who unsubscribed themselves are never changed and are counted in
    `skipped_unsubscribed`. Upsert never deletes — remove departed users with
    `DELETE .../recipients/{identifier}` or `POST .../recipients/remove`.
    Retries are safe: an unchanged entry is counted in `unchanged`. The whole
    batch is rejected (400) if it would exceed 500 active recipients.

    ## Authentication
    Requires an API token (created in the dashboard). Pass it as a Bearer
    token in the Authorization header:
    ```
    Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN
    ```
    The list must belong to the token's project. List ids come from
    `GET /email/lists`.

post.description:
Soft-removes up to 1000 recipients by `emails` and/or `external_ids`.
    Removed contacts stop receiving release emails but keep their row, so a
    later upsert or add reactivates them. Contacts who unsubscribed themselves
    stay unsubscribed (counted in `skipped_unsubscribed`). Identifiers that
    match nothing are listed in `not_found`. Idempotent.

    ## Authentication
    Requires an API token (created in the dashboard). Pass it as a Bearer
    token in the Authorization header:
    ```
    Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN
    ```
    The list must belong to the token's project. List ids come from
    `GET /email/lists`.

delete.description:
Soft-removes a single recipient. `identifier` is matched as an email
    address first (case-insensitive), then as an `external_id`. Returns
    `{"status": "removed" | "already_removed" | "unsubscribed"}` — an
    unsubscribed contact is left as is. 404 when neither matches. Idempotent.

    ## Authentication
    Requires an API token (created in the dashboard). Pass it as a Bearer
    token in the Authorization header:
    ```
    Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN
    ```
    The list must belong to the token's project. List ids come from
    `GET /email/lists`.
